entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
I can certainly look into that for you. Could I get your name and order number, please?
Thank you, Sarah. I see the order was delivered on December 15th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
The pulse reading is complete garbage. It's wildly inaccurate.

I'm sorry to hear you're experiencing trouble with the pulse sensor. I can transfer you to our technical support team. They have a few troubleshooting steps that can usually resolve sensor inaccuracies right away.
No. I don't have time for all that. I just want my money back for the item. I'm not interested in fixing it.
I understand you'd prefer not to troubleshoot. Let me just pull up the return eligibility for your order. One moment, please.
Okay, I've got your details here. I see it's been 42 days since delivery, and our policy allows for returns within 90 days. So you're well within the window.

Yes, I can do that for you now. I've just initiated the return authorization. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label in the next few minutes. Just pack the sensor in its original box, attach the label, and drop it in the mail.
Fine. When will I get the money?
Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 5-7 business days.
I'm glad I could get that sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
